adopt a policy: Many schools have adopted a policy that bans phones in class to help students focus.
許多學校已採行禁止上課使用手機的政策，以幫助學生專心。
adopt a new approach: When the old teaching method failed, Ms. Lin decided to adopt a new approach based on group games.
舊的教學方法失敗後，林老師決定採用以小組遊戲為主的新方法。
adopt a child: After years of trying to have a baby, the couple decided to adopt a child from an orphanage.
多年嘗試生小孩未果後，這對夫妻決定從孤兒院領養一個小孩。
adopt a positive attitude: Doctors say that patients who adopt a positive attitude often recover faster after surgery.
醫生說，抱持正面態度的病人在手術後往往恢復得較快。
adopt a name: When the singer moved to Hollywood, she decided to adopt a name that was easier for Americans to say.
那位歌手搬到好萊塢後，決定採用一個美國人比較容易唸的名字。
advocate reform: Many teachers advocate reform of the exam system so that students feel less pressure.
許多老師倡導改革考試制度，好讓學生感受較少壓力。
advocate for the poor: The young lawyer spends her weekends working to advocate for the poor who cannot pay for legal help.
那位年輕律師利用週末為付不起法律協助的窮人發聲。
advocate a ban on smoking: Health groups advocate a ban on smoking in all parks because secondhand smoke harms children.
衛生團體主張在所有公園禁菸，因為二手菸會傷害孩童。
can't afford to lose: This is the final game of the season, and we can't afford to lose if we want to win the championship.
這是本季最後一場比賽，如果我們想奪冠就輸不起。
afford an opportunity: The summer camp will afford an opportunity for students to practice English with native speakers.
這個夏令營將提供學生和母語人士練習英語的機會。
can't afford the time: I'd love to join the trip, but with exams next week, I can't afford the time.
我很想參加這趟旅行，但下週要考試，我抽不出時間。
afford protection: The thick walls of the old castle afford protection against both strong winds and enemy attacks.
那座古堡的厚牆能提供保護，抵禦強風和敵人的攻擊。
alert the police: A neighbor heard someone breaking the window and quickly called to alert the police.
一位鄰居聽到有人打破窗戶，便迅速打電話通報警方。
alert the public to the danger: The news report aims to alert the public to the danger of swimming in rivers after heavy rain.
這則新聞報導旨在提醒大眾注意大雨後在河裡游泳的危險。
be alerted to a problem: The engineers were alerted to a problem when a red light suddenly flashed on the control panel.
控制面板上突然閃起紅燈時，工程師們就獲悉出了問題。
allocate funds: The city council voted to allocate funds for building a new park near the train station.
市議會投票通過分配經費，在火車站附近興建一座新公園。
allocate time: Good students allocate time wisely, spending more hours on the subjects they find most difficult.
好學生會明智地分配時間，把更多時數花在他們覺得最難的科目上。
allocate resources: During the earthquake, the government had to allocate resources such as food and tents to the worst-hit towns.
地震期間，政府必須把食物和帳篷等資源配置給受災最嚴重的城鎮。
allocate tasks: Before the class party, our leader allocated tasks so that everyone knew what to bring.
班級派對前，我們的班長分派任務，讓每個人都知道要帶什麼。
alter the course of history: The invention of the printing press helped to alter the course of history by spreading knowledge quickly.
印刷術的發明藉由迅速傳播知識，幫助改變了歷史走向。
alter one's plans: Because of the sudden typhoon, we had to alter our plans and stay home instead of going to the beach.
因為突來的颱風，我們只好更改計畫，留在家裡而不去海邊。
alter a dress: The dress was too long for her, so she asked the tailor to alter a dress before the party.
那件洋裝對她來說太長，所以她請裁縫在派對前修改洋裝。
alter one's opinion: After watching the documentary about factory farms, he altered his opinion about eating meat.
看了關於工廠化農場的紀錄片後，他改變了對吃肉的看法。
amend the law: Lawmakers plan to amend the law so that drunk drivers will face much heavier fines.
立法委員計畫修法，讓酒駕者面臨更重的罰款。
amend the constitution: To lower the voting age to eighteen, the country first needed to amend the constitution.
為了把投票年齡降到十八歲，該國首先需要修憲。
amend a proposal: During the meeting, members voted to amend a proposal by adding a new section about student safety.
會議期間，成員投票修改一項提案，加入一個關於學生安全的新條款。
analyze the data: Scientists will analyze the data from the survey to find out why teenagers sleep so little.
科學家們將分析調查得到的數據，找出青少年睡得這麼少的原因。
analyze the situation: Before making any decision, the general took time to analyze the situation on the battlefield.
在做任何決定之前，將軍花時間分析戰場上的情勢。
analyze the causes: The report tries to analyze the causes of the traffic accident, such as bad weather and speeding.
這份報告試圖分析那起車禍的原因，例如惡劣天候和超速。
